text:
Roman Josi is 36 and still playing more than 25 minutes a night for the Predators, which tells you plenty. He has 24 points in 24 games, 22 of them assists, and 11 on the power play. The former Norris Trophy winner remains the center of Nashville's offense from the back end.

The goals are the part that's off. He has two on 4.58 expected (expected goals measure the quality of chances), shooting 3.1% from a defenseman who usually beats that. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking last season had him getting to the dangerous ice in front of the net more than most defensemen, 84th percentile, so the looks are there. At even strength, Nashville has 52.85% of the expected goals with him on, 7.45 points better than without. Our numbers project 74 points, in a range of 62 to 86. The assists are steady; watch for the goals to start following the chances.
headline: Roman Josi at 36 is still running Nashville
